title: Provision lore agent profiles for specialist dispatch
description: The opum-workflow specialist agents (reviewer, implementer, verifier, documenter) are gated on lore review context packs whose profiles live in .lore/agents/, and ward-cli is the only fleet repository with none (verified by the orchestrator 2026-09-28). Provision .lore/agents/review.toml, implementation.toml, verification.toml and documentation.toml, modeled on a sibling repository's profiles (read by ref, e.g. opum-fleet origin/dev), with the sources adjusted to ward-cli's own docs bundle (docs/adr/, docs/index.md). Acceptance: the four profiles exist and lore agent context review compiles a pack that names ward-cli sources; CI stays green (lore check, docs gate).
implementationNotes: Handoff, 2026-09-28, session renewal at the WCLI-20 boundary (orchestrator OPAG-475). The successor starts WCLI-24 here. Context: the opum-workflow reviewer specialist refuses dispatch in this repo because its lore context pack needs .lore/agents/review.toml, and ward-cli has never had any lore agent profiles (the only fleet repo without them; verified by the orchestrator by ref). Task, per the orchestrator: provision .lore/agents/ with review, implementation, verification and documentation profiles, modeled on a sibling read by ref (e.g. git -C ../opum-fleet show origin/dev:.lore/agents/review.toml), with sources adjusted to ward-cli's own docs bundle. Acceptance: the four profiles exist; lore agent context review compiles a pack naming ward-cli sources; CI stays green (the Docs job runs lore check). Method notes: (1) merge authority is not inherited — ask your own user before gh pr merge. (2) The profiles are committed under .lore/, which is not gitignored; land via the usual branch+PR path. (3) Part 2 of the original finding (lore agent context review exits 0 with a warning where the reviewer protocol documented exit 3) was ruled behaviour and routed to opum-fleet — nothing to do here. Skills for the successor: opum-handoff restore, opum-sdlc, lore.
